title: Term Life Insurance Conversion Privilege Specifications
content:
The conversion privilege of Term Life Insurance differs by tier in its length, its age limit and the permanent products offered.

| | Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term | Ashgrove Level Term 10 | Ashgrove Level Term 15 | Ashgrove Level Term 20 | Ashgrove Level Term 25 | Ashgrove Level Term 30 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Conversion period from the issue date | 60 calendar months | 120 calendar months | 180 calendar months | 180 calendar months | 180 calendar months | 180 calendar months |
| Attained age limit (conversion must be completed before the anniversary on or after this age) | 65 | 70 | 70 | 70 | 70 | 70 |
| Full-menu period from the issue date | 24 calendar months | 60 calendar months | 60 calendar months | 60 calendar months | 60 calendar months | 60 calendar months |
| Smallest face amount converted in one conversion (USD) | 25000 | 25000 | 25000 | 25000 | 25000 | 25000 |

### Products available

| Tier | Within the full-menu period | After the full-menu period (designated products only) |
|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term | Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100, Ashgrove Protection UL, Ashgrove Accumulation UL | Ashgrove Protection UL |
| Ashgrove Level Term 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 | Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100, Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65, Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life, Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL, Ashgrove Protection UL, Ashgrove Accumulation UL, Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth | Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100, Ashgrove Protection UL |

Example (hypothetical): on an Ashgrove Level Term 20 in its 7th policy year (past 60 months), the products available are only the Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 and the Ashgrove Protection UL.
